title: Spotify investor news and press releases
excerpt: Spotify's investor-relations feed lists its June 25 announcement for second-quarter 2026 results; the results are scheduled for August 4, 2026 before the U.S. market open.
summary: Official investor-relations press-release feed checked before the scheduled Q2 2026 release. The imminent August 4 earnings event makes the July 28 upper-band transition vulnerable to expectation-driven volatility; no Q2 result was available at the research cutoff.
